_note: Card art prompts, keyed by card id, apart from card content: changing a card's mechanics changes neither its art nor its prompt. A card's full prompt is style + its entry. Per-card prompts for the whole set come later.
style: Painted science-fiction illustration for a board game card, wide landscape composition, dramatic but readable at card size, rich light and colour, a single clear subject, no text, letters, numbers, logos or interface.

cards.mutual_defense_pact: Two allied air-defence batteries on a coastline at dusk, their radar beams meeting overhead into a single shield of light.
cards.antiproton_offtake_deal: A vast magnetic containment ring in a floodlit hall, a single violet thread of antimatter being drawn off into a sealed flask.
cards.embassy_compound: A walled diplomatic compound of glass and white stone at night, flags lit, a line of envoys crossing its courtyard.
cards.orbital_embassy: A slender embassy station in low orbit above a blue planet, with shuttles of many nations docking along its ring.
cards.hardpoint_lockdown: Blast shutters slamming down across a city's bridges and gates under red emergency light.
cards.adversarial_inference_sweep: A wave of luminous probes sweeping through a black lattice of servers, each struck node bleeding light.
cards.telemetry_archive: Endless racks of glowing tape spools in a cold vault, instrument readings scrolling across them as streams of light.
cards.exabyte_archive: A cathedral-sized data vault of crystal storage columns rising into darkness, lit from within.
